headline: Helping brands get cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity | AI Search Visibility (AEO/GEO) @ Searchable
about:
As founding SDR at Searchable, I run outbound across marketing teams, agencies, SaaS, and DTC and e-commerce brands. My job is to start the conversation most companies haven't had yet: how their brand shows up when buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Gemini for a recommendation, and what to do about it.
 
Searchable is the AI search optimisation platform built for this shift. We track how brands get mentioned, cited, and recommended across the 10 major AI answer engines, then show teams exactly what to fix. I get to be the first point of contact for the people figuring this out, which means a lot of honest, early-stage conversations rather than pitches.
 
I care about doing this properly. That means leading with real numbers (we track 550M+ citations and 275M+ mentions, and we show the working), respecting people's time, and being useful before I ask for anything. Backed by a $14M seed from Headline, 4.8/5 on G2, and a Slack community of 1,000+ marketers, Searchable is where I get to build that habit at the front of a brand-new category.

I hold a Diploma in Sales Management, dual Bachelor's degrees in HR and Psychology, and I’ve earned multiple awards for transformative leadership across both high-growth tech and global operations. From Kantata to McDonald’s Australia, I’ve always been driven by solving problems, developing people, and scaling with purpose.

I’m especially passionate about start-up tech, global business, and continuously growing as a leader. I’m always open to connecting with others who share the same values.

TL:DR

I’ve always been drawn to building products.

Age 20: Division 1 football (P/K) while studying at Cornell University, Utah State University, and University at Albany (MBA).
Age 22: Built my first startup, Hirebird, an AI hiring platform. (Exited)
Age 23: Worked as a design engineer at a YC-backed startup building product and growth systems.
Age 24+: Started focusing on the intersection of product design, AI systems, and search.

Today: Co-founder of Searchable.

What I do now

Through Searchable we help companies understand and influence how AI models talk about their brand.

Searchable helps monitor brand visibility across models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude through prompts, and data to help teams understand when they are recommended, cited, or missed entirely in AI.

If you’re a founder, marketer, or growth team trying to understand how AI platforms recommend products and companies, that’s what we work on every day.

Always building. Always shipping.

If you’re working on something interesting in AI search, product, or growth... let’s connect!

about:
Search has been changing fast and I've been right in the middle of it watching it unfold.
 
Most of my time on LinkedIn goes to breaking down AI search by asking questions and writing about them. The main goal is to provide practical takes on how brands build real influence in this new era of search.
 
As part of the founding team at Searchable, I'm helping build our US GTM motion from scratch. A huge part of that has been helping agencies figure out how to package, position, and sell AI search services to their clients. In many ways, we’ve been building a category that didn’t even have a name a year ago.
 
Outside of working with brands, I'm building sales enablement, helping position us in the market, and shipping internal tools that make our team faster. I also build customer-facing tools that improve workflows and solve practical problems. 
 
I've learned most of what I know by doing it, talking to hundreds of teams, and staying curious.
 
When I'm not deep in search and AI, I'm with my wonderful wife and daughter.
